entities.summary: Jamaica is a sovereign nation in Caribbean, Americas. Its capital is Kingston. Official languages include English. Government: Unitary parliamentary constitutional monarchy (Commonwealth realm). Population: approximately 2.8 million. Area: 10,991 km². Comprehensive index for Jamaica covering Taíno (Xaymaca, 'land of wood and water'), Columbus 1494, Spanish colonization, English conquest 1655, Port Royal (pirate capital, earthquake 1692), sugar/slavery powerhouse, Maroons (Nanny, Cudjoe, treaty 1739), Sam Sharpe's Rebellion 1831, emancipation 1834, Morant Bay Rebellion 1865, banana era, Marcus Garvey, independence 1962, Bob Marley/reggae/ska, Rastafari, and bauxite/tourism economy.
